milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The oak sapling is placed at spawn-relative [3, 0, 2]. The player must be within 16 blocks and face toward it (within 60°). This correctly models 'player can see the target' without requiring them to stand on top of it. The sapling is ~3.6 blocks from spawn so distance is easily satisfied, but the facing requirement ensures intentional observation.

Uses inventory_has because crafting an oak_pressure_plate results in the item appearing in the player's inventory. The player must mine oak logs, craft them into oak planks (in 2x2 inventory grid or crafting table), then craft 2 oak planks into an oak_pressure_plate. The item is not in the starting inventory, so detecting min_count=1 confirms successful crafting.
